question: A 37-year-old man presents to his primary care physician because he has had constipation for the last several weeks. He has also been feeling lethargic and complains that this winter has been particularly cold. He also complains that he has been gaining weight despite no change in his normal activities. He reveals that two months prior to presentation he had what felt like the flu for which he took tylenol and did not seek medical attention. Several days after this he developed anterior neck pain. Which of the following findings would most likely be seen on biopsy of this patient's abnormality?
